# Data Table

A real table: the caption names it, and it scrolls instead of becoming cards.

In `library/components/data-table/` — copy `component.{html,css}`, read `docs.md` for why.

**Root:** `.ac-table`, `.ac-table-scroll`

## ARIA

- **a column header** — `scope=col`
- **a row header** — `scope=row`
- **the scroll wrapper** — `tabindex=0` `role=region` `aria-labelledby`

## Keyboard

- `Tab` — the scroll wrapper is a stop, so it needs a role and a name (SC 2.1.1)

## Goes wrong when

- every cell a td, with the header row bolded in CSS
- scope=col only, so the column is named and the row is not
- overflow-x:auto alone: Chromium hands it a tab stop with no role and no name
- a paragraph styled to look like a caption, which names nothing
- display:block for cards on mobile, which doubles the announcement through td::before content
- a base rule written .ac-table th, .ac-table td — (0,1,1) outranks every single-class modifier

WCAG 1.3.1 1.4.1 1.4.10 2.1.1 2.4.7 4.1.2 · [APG](https://www.w3.org/WAI/tutorials/tables/) · see also `prose-surface`, `typography`
